Discover Garnier Watermelon Hair Food Conditioner for Fine Hair. Made of 97% Natural Origin Ingredients with Watermlelon extract, our formula cleanses your hair and leaves it feeling plumped.

In 1 use, your hair is up to 8X smoother. (Instrumental test. Watermelon Hair Food Shampoo + Conditioner vs. Classical Shampoo on bleached hair). For optimal results, use this Conditioner with the Hair Food Watermelon Shampoo & Mask.

Product Information

Dig into Garnier Hair Food Watermelon Conditioner to help detangle and plump fine hair, blended with Watermelon & Pomegranate.

It’s ultra-melting, lightweight texture instantly absorbs to quickly detangle and condition. Hair is left looking healthy and plumped. Super Food for Super Hair! 97% Natural Origin Ingredients and 100% Vegan Formula* blended with Watermelon and Pomegranate (*no animal ingredients or by-products) .

Discover our full Watermelon Hair Food range and try our Watermelon Shampoo, Conditioner and 3-in-1 Hair Treatment for Fine Hair.

Officially approved by Cruelty Free International under the Leaping Bunny Programme

Recycling Instructions
Instructions may vary locally
 

Instructions of Use

How to apply Hair Food Conditioner: as usual!

1. After shampoo, squeeze, massage into wet hair, rinse thoroughly.

2. For more intense nourishment dig into our 3-in-1 multi-use mask!

Consumer Benefits

• Garnier Hair Food Watermelon Shampoo Conditions & Plumps Fine Hair 
• It’s ultra-melting, lightweight texture instantly absorbs to quickly detangle and condition 
• YES 97% Natural Origin Ingredients – Blended with Watermelon & Pomegranate 
• YES Vegan Formula - No animal ingredients or by-products 
• NO Silicones for a natural feel
